about: docs/adr/0038 decision 3: the rules of core/Scenes/jetrover-mixed.json, a mixed pool, written by SceneMixedTests (just gen-isaac-goldens). objects: name, role, steps (min, max, or empty), supports (ids). fits: index, rest, scale, x, y, yaw, FitsOnTable at the yaw, FitsOnTable without one. overlaps: a, x, y, z, yaw, rest, scale, b, x, y, z, yaw, rest, scale, OverlapsAtHeights. holds: stand, x, y, z, yaw, scale, object, x, y, z, rest, scale, HoldsOnTop. elevated: index, rest, scale, z, RestingZ, IsElevated. pool: obstacleMin, obstacleMax, distractorMin, distractorMax, reachMin, reachMax, reachBearing, standShare, rigShare, distractorReach, then the second pass's tallShare, workMin, workMax, workBearing, standTopMin, standTopMax, rigUnderMin, rigUnderMax; each object's fifth column is 1 for a tall thin obstacle (IsTall).
